**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **What I checked:** the planner's candidate pricing sections (§4.1 Charges, §4.2 Payment), plus full-document searches for MFN vocabulary ("no less favorable", "most favored", "favourable", "best price", "discount", "any other customer", "exclusiv"). I also read §14.16 (Freedom of Action) as the nearest structurally-related provision.
- **Result:** there is no MFN mechanic in the agreement running in either direction. Charges are set purely by Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with no obligation for Bluefly to match or extend third-party terms to IBM. §14.16 ("Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.") cuts further against any implied best-terms commitment.
- **Direction check:** nothing here burdens the Customer, so the rule's flag condition is not triggered. This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer), not merely the fallback.
- **Noted, not flagged:** there is also no vendor-granted MFN in our favour. That is a commercial upside to pursue if pricing leverage allows, but its absence is not a playbook deviation under this rule.
